scope: Authored opt-in controls for the live restore barrier and the generated ALLOC_CLO(4) site. This file is not an evidence-recipe and was not submitted to research --run. No compiler, gsi, or source-core process was started.
productionWhenMacroUndefined: ___GAMBIT_DEV_RESTORE_PROBE is undefined in the production makefiles. The preprocessor then removes every new call. The remaining BARRIER(), SYNC_GET_MSG, ___ALLOC_CLO, ___BEGIN_SETUP_CLO, ___ADD_CLO_ELEM and ___R_HEAP_EXPR tokens are the previous expansions. This was checked by reading the ifdef branches. It was not checked by compiling.

diagnosticImage.headerRegenerationRequired: The closure, census, and reload hooks live in include/_gambit/module_generation.h.in, include/_gambit/object_access.h.in, include/_gambit/stack_operations.h.in and include/_gambit/header_end.h.in. include/gambit.h was not edited and configure was not run, so the current aggregate header does not contain those hooks.

modes.unset: Hooks return. The barrier is not skipped, the process does not exit, and the closure store is unchanged. This image still contains the calls, so it is not the production image. With the macro undefined, the production ___ALLOC, ___ALLOC_CLO, ___R_HEAP_EXPR and header-store tokens are unchanged. That comparison is text inspection.
modes.positive: Processor 1 waits on the existing final old-section read. Processor 0 is observed inside barrier_sync_op before that reader is released. Expected stderr includes DEV-RESTORE-BARRIER-POSITIVE p2 reader-finished=1 observed-after=0. After prepare_mem_pstate publishes the cursor, the host reload assigns ___hp from ___PSHEAP and does not read the uninitialized local. The first hooked allocation is decisive. A fitting ALLOC_CLO(4) at that processor, cursor and physical range performs the header store and bump, which only arms the witness. BEGIN_SETUP_CLO then stores the label and trampoline and records that body. DEV-FIRST-CLOSURE-POSITIVE is printed only after the ADD_CLO_ELEM store that completes indices 0..3 of that same body. The line includes init=fields-completed, label-trampoline=sequenced, macro-entry=claimed, direct-hp=hooked, still=uninstrumented, rc=uninstrumented and first-allocation=inconclusive. The ALLOC_CLO expression result remains ___GET_SUBTYPED. Setup or field writes of any other closure return without a positive line. A direct ___hp entry that wins the first slot exits 79 before its write.
modes.negative: Processor 0 skips only the restore BARRIER() and _Exit(0) before retire_section_claims and later barriers. Expected stderr is DEV-RESTORE-BARRIER-NEGATIVE p2 reader-finished=1 observed-after=1 and no FIRST-CLOSURE line. A closure call after that barrier has started and before it passed prints DEV-FIRST-CLOSURE-NEGATIVE premature and exits 79 before the header store.
modes.closure-negative: The real barrier runs and must report the POSITIVE barrier line. If the first hooked post-reload allocation is the fitting ALLOC_CLO(4) at the published cursor, it prints DEV-FIRST-CLOSURE-NEGATIVE rejected-before-write and _Exit(0) before ___hp[0] is stored. A first hooked allocation of another kind prints DEV-FIRST-ALLOC-OTHER and exits 79 before that store or bump.

diagnosticImage.wordCount: The pre-write call receives the ALLOC_CLO free-variable count and the total n+___CLO_FREEVARS+___SUBTYPED_BODY. The historical image reported words=6. This opt-in does not hard-code 6. The header-and-bump call arms the witness only when the bump distance and stored header match that binding. The positive line also requires the label hook and all four free-field stores of that same closure. A first closure whose free-variable count is not 4 exits 79 with DEV-FIRST-CLOSURE-UNEXPECTED before the store and is not called a thread-join witness. In the probe expansion, n is evaluated twice before the production BEGIN, END and GET evaluations. Each ADD_CLO_ELEM evaluates its index and value once, stores, then calls the hook. Generated sites pass integer literals.
limitations: Two processors and the one restore BARRIER() after move_continuation only.
The reader hook is the existing final-word hook, so an empty copy does not arm it.
The allocation window is thread-local and starts only after dev_barrier_passed, prepare_mem_pstate and a reload of the published cursor.
observed-after stays 0 on the positive path because the reader is released only after the sample, not because a 50 ms sleep is a proof.

Hooked macro header stores and ___ALLOC or ___ALLOC_ALIGN64 bumps are censused. The first of those claims the slot. An earlier invalid closure, cursor gap, or other kind rejects before its write and is not replaced by a later fitting closure.

Direct ___hp writes in the kernel, system and number generators are hooked before the mutation. ___alloc_scmobj and ___alloc_rc are not hooked. The closure line therefore says first-allocation=inconclusive and is not a complete first-allocation proof. The reload hook does not read the uninitialized local ___hp. A later reload records a gap only when the published cursor differs from a cursor this probe stored.
The field witness is only the bound closure's BEGIN_SETUP_CLO and ADD_CLO_ELEM hooks. ___SET_CLO and any other field write are not hooked and are not counted as initialization.
The first-slot claim is the first hooked entry, not a cross-processor fence around the store.
Unknown environment values exit 77. A missed handshake exits 78.
include/gambit.h was not edited and configure was not run. The current aggregate header does not contain these hooks. Nothing was compiled or executed.
